title: Join fruits, vegetables and animal products into food_stuff_tp
description:
Create fruits, vegetables and animal products tuples. Join the three tuples and assign it to a variable called food_stuff_tp.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as create_food_stuff_tp(fruits, vegetables, animal_products), where each argument is a tuple, returning food_stuff_tp as the concatenation of fruits, then vegetables, then animal_products.
hints: You already joined two tuples with siblings earlier - joining three tuples works the same way, just with one more +.
Order matters: the result should list all of fruits, then all of vegetables, then all of animal_products.
Return fruits + vegetables + animal_products - chaining the + operator concatenates all three in order.
expected_behavior: Returns the concatenation of fruits, vegetables and animal_products, in that order, as one tuple.
solution:
def create_food_stuff_tp(fruits, vegetables, animal_products):
    return fruits + vegetables + animal_products
explanation: The + operator concatenates tuples pairwise and can be chained, so fruits + vegetables + animal_products produces one tuple containing every item from all three, in order.
